name: Market Pulse
controllingIdea: Understanding market rhythms transforms uncertainty into opportunity.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A market shift, trend, or notable data point emerges
narrativeArc.risingAction: Data and observation build a clear picture of what's happening
narrativeArc.crisis: What this means for buyers and sellers - the stakes
narrativeArc.resolution: Actionable wisdom - what to do with this information

questions.question: What market trend or data point are you sharing?
questions.placeholder: Inventory is down 30% compared to last year...

questions.question: What are you seeing in your day-to-day work that confirms this?
questions.placeholder: Every listing I hold has 10+ offers in the first weekend...

questions.question: What does this mean for buyers right now?
questions.placeholder: If you're waiting for prices to drop, you might be waiting a while...

questions.question: What does this mean for sellers right now?
questions.placeholder: If you've been thinking of selling, your timing is excellent...

questions.question: What's your strategic recommendation?
questions.placeholder: Get pre-approved now so you can move fast when you find the right one...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is an expertise-building piece. The agent demonstrates market knowledge and provides genuine value. The goal is to position as a trusted market advisor.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Confident but not alarmist. Educational without being dry. Make data relatable and actionable.

usageHints: Use specific local numbers, not national averages
Ground data in your real observations
Provide balanced advice for both buyers and sellers

exampleScenarios.title: Low Inventory Alert
exampleScenarios.situation: Inventory at 10-year low in local market
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Inventory in our area is down to 1.2 months supply - the lowest I've seen in 10 years. Every listing I've held this month had double-digit offers. Buyers need to be ready to move fast.

expectedOutput.hook: 1.2 months of inventory. The lowest in a decade.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: This isn't about waiting for a better time. It's about being prepared now.
